Evidence

The landing’s three numbers, unpacked. Counts are from the runs in TESTING.md. Device: no. Meta key: no.

The three numbers
5 pieces
The synthetic room yadori_den reports five labelled meshes: couch, lamp, plant, screen, table.
0 keys
The browser never sees MODEL_API_KEY. Only the gateway reads it, and the contract tests assert it is never echoed.
1 pinch
One hand pinch wakes the couch. The face centre sat on the computed target at 0.00 cm (limit 1 cm).

Also measured Oct 25: XR CPU p50 0.70 ms, p95 1.00 ms, 26 draw calls; 82 unit tests; emulator 21/21; glasses profile 8/8; browser diorama 18/18; responsive 12/12. Quest frame time is unverified. Full table: TESTING.md.

How a wake works
Point and pinch. Quest Space Setup (or the emulator room) already holds furniture-sized boxes. A hand ray draws a dotted outline and a label chip. Pinch, or click in the browser.
A face blooms. On the side that faces you, in its upper third, 1 cm proud of the surface, held by a WebXR anchor. It blinks, follows you, and turns at most 40° toward you.
Poke, pet, flick. A fingertip poke makes it jump. A slow palm stroke makes it purr. A flick sends it spinning and grumpy. In the browser: tap, rub, swipe.
Wake a second. With a key, Muse Spark writes a persona from the label and the neighbours, and ask_object lets them gossip (at most two hops). Without a key you type both lines. Puppet mode, labelled.
The binder

Each woken object is a card. Six spirits at most, because a site gets eight persistent anchors. These two pockets are from a recorded IWER run, not from a real home.

With the key. Muse Spark, six tools.

Right now. Puppet mode. You type the lines.

Voice in

With the key. Muse Voice Transcribe.

Right now. Typing.

Voice out

With the weights. Meta MMS-TTS, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0.

Right now. After fetch-models.sh, or the browser voice, labelled.

Anchors, gestures, gaze, gossip

Either way. Local. The same code.

Right now. Identical. No network model.

Never a canned reply. Without the key, chat, transcribe and cut return 503 setup_required.

How to open it
No headset. pnpm gateway, then pnpm --filter app dev, then open https://localhost:8091/. The room is labelled “Browser diorama, not your room”. Click a piece of furniture.
Desktop emulator. On that same page, “Enter mixed reality (emulated)” uses IWER’s synthetic room. Hands only.
Quest 3 / 3S. Run Space Setup so the furniture is labelled, open the app in the Quest browser, enter mixed reality, point and pinch. Not run on a headset yet. Steps: docs/QUEST.md.
